title: Omi TV · v3

panels.title: Growth · active users
panels.description: Users are deduplicated persons with qualified use (v2 definitions): a capture, conversation, chat or ≥2 successful MCP calls on a UTC day, not just an app open. Weekly, daily and monthly users over the trailing 7 / 1 / 30 complete UTC days (MCP-only included). Change below: relative % vs the prior 7 / 1 / 30 days.
Growth: change vs the prior period, from the series API.

panels.title: Weekly users by platform
panels.description: Users are deduplicated persons with qualified use (v2 definitions): a capture, conversation, chat or ≥2 successful MCP calls on a UTC day, not just an app open. Trailing 7-day periods ending each date (UTC), stacked by each user's primary platform. Starts at the first period after mobile telemetry began (week of 2026-05-04); earlier periods undercount mobile and are not drawn. MCP-only = users whose only qualified use was ≥2 successful MCP calls on a day (blank before that marker existed). The latest bar is the weekly-users stat.

panels.title: New, returning & lost users
panels.description: Each week's active users = returning (also active the prior 7 days) + back after a break + new (first seen this week). Lost = last week's users not active this week, drawn below zero.

panels.title: Quick ratio
panels.description: Users gained ÷ users lost each week: (new + back after a break) ÷ lost. Above the dashed 1.0 line the active base is growing.

panels.title: Stickiness (DAU/WAU)
panels.description: Average daily users ÷ weekly users: qualified user-days in the 7-day period ÷ (7 × weekly users). 100% = every weekly user is active every day.

panels.title: Activation · week one
panels.description: Activated: new users (first seen in the weekly cohort, 180-day lookback so returning users are not counted as new) with ≥2 qualified days in days 1–7. Saved capture: share of the same cohort with a saved own-device or mic capture in week one, the main activation driver. Change below in percentage points vs the prior weekly cohort.
Activation: change vs the prior period, from the series API.

panels.title: Activation by platform
panels.description: Week-one activation for weekly new-user cohorts, dated by the cohort's last day, split by the platform users first arrived on. Rates use the full cohort, including users who never qualified. The latest All point is the Activated stat. "Other" platform cohorts are a handful of users, so their rate is in the tooltip only. The shaded band on the right is cohorts still inside their first week: a cohort is drawn 8 days after its last first-seen day, and a new one is added every day, so the line always ends 8 days back.

panels.title: Week-one capture
panels.description: Share of each new-user cohort with a saved, non-discarded own-device or mic conversation in days 1–7, by first platform. The latest All point is the Saved capture stat. The shaded band on the right is cohorts still inside their first week: a cohort is drawn 8 days after its last first-seen day, and a new one is added every day, so the line always ends 8 days back.

panels.title: Activation by capture
panels.description: Latest matured new-user cohort (the Activated stat's cohort), split by what users captured with in week one, largest group first: phone mic, an Omi pendant, "Other Omi" (another or unknown Omi model), "2+ devices", Limitless, Apple Watch, another device, Mac only, phone + Mac, or nothing saved. Bars are each group's week-one activation; the group's user count is in the label. Groups sum to the cohort.

panels.title: Retention
panels.description: If activated: activated new users who qualify again in days 8–37 (the cohort needs 37 days to mature, so this is the cohort that started ~5 weeks ago). Established: users active in both of the prior two weeks who are active this week. Change below in percentage points vs the prior cohort / week.
Retention: change vs the prior period, from the series API.

panels.title: Weekly cohort retention
panels.description: W0–W8: share of each weekly new-user cohort (180-day history check, as the activation stat) with a qualified day in week k after first seen. Only fully observed weeks are drawn, so the newest cohort is a single W0 point. Older cohorts are dimmer; the newest is brightest and thickest. Legend oldest → newest.

panels.title: Retention by week
panels.description: Established retention by week (solid) and retained-if-activated (dashed) by the cohort's last first-seen day. Retained-if-activated needs 37 days to mature, so its line always ends 38 days back; the violet band is the cohorts still maturing (a new one closes every day). Established ends at the last complete Mon–Sun week. Latest points are the stats.

panels.title: Power users · days active
panels.description: Share of weekly users by number of active days in the latest 7 days (white), against the same period 4 weeks earlier (grey). A rise on the right means habitual use.

panels.title: Revenue
panels.description: MRR: live Stripe Omi-plan book (change = same-source FinOps 7-day change). Per user = MRR ÷ monthly users (qualified MAU; change vs prior week). Hardware: Shopify net device sales, last complete Mon–Sun week vs the prior week. Relative % change.
Revenue: change vs the prior period, from the series API.

panels.title: MRR by plan
panels.description: Neo = legacy Unlimited (plan id unlimited), Unlimited = unlimited_v2, Pro = operator. Daily FinOps snapshots of the Stripe plan book (deduplicated by snapshot date; known gaps: an unmapped enterprise price and two JPY subscriptions). The final point is the live Stripe book, the MRR stat. Shopify plan prepay is cash and never included.

panels.title: Shopify sales per week
panels.description: Mon–Sun weeks. Net device sales (refunds restate their sale week, no tax/shipping) and Omi Unlimited plan prepay cash (reported separately, never MRR). Device units in the tooltip. The latest Hardware bar is the Hardware stat.

panels.title: Margin by plan
panels.description: Allocated estimate, not gross margin. Revenue = that day's FinOps MRR ÷ 30.4. Cost = FinOps fully-loaded plan cost + the shared pool (TV all-in − FinOps: BigQuery, STT, SaaS) split by each plan's cost-active user-days. Lines: margin % (left); Free: −$/day bars (right); $/day and the unattributed row in the tooltip. FinOps plan cost settles ~3 days back, so this chart ends earlier than the wall (line below); a day without both cost and revenue is a gap. Caveats: STT is not invoiced per plan (vendor cost is pooled; GCP audio is allocated by speech seconds), and plan membership comes from a point-in-time snapshot.

Margin by plan's last day with both a settled FinOps plan cost and a book snapshot, and the source used for each all-in line. Estimates are dated and marked stale after 35 days; measured SaaS is labeled from Mercury.

panels.title: Health
panels.description: All-in cost counts every line: GCP net of committed-use credits (one-time incidents excluded), Vertex/Gemini LLM, OpenAI and Anthropic invoices, STT and SaaS. STT uses the dated $5.3K/month Soniox-console estimate as of 2026-10-16 until a measured FinOps line exists (the FinOps stt_vendor_low model overstated it ~2×). SaaS uses the dated fixed $4.8K/month estimate as of 2026-10-16 until a complete fresh Mercury row exists, then it is measured SaaS (Mercury). Measured lines are labeled by source; an estimate older than 35 days is marked stale under Margin by plan. Cost / day is the settled day D−2; cost / user is the 30-day all-in cost ÷ monthly users. MAU here is qualified MAU (~10K). The "Omi Cost vs Revenue" artifact divides by any-event PostHog MAU (~22K, $3.41 in October), so its per-user cost is about half of this one. Relative % change; up is bad.
Health: change vs the prior period, from the series API.

panels.title: Cost vs revenue
panels.description: All-in cost counts every line: GCP net of committed-use credits (one-time incidents excluded), Vertex/Gemini LLM, OpenAI and Anthropic invoices, STT and SaaS. STT uses the dated $5.3K/month Soniox-console estimate as of 2026-10-16 until a measured FinOps line exists (the FinOps stt_vendor_low model overstated it ~2×). SaaS uses the dated fixed $4.8K/month estimate as of 2026-10-16 until a complete fresh Mercury row exists, then it is measured SaaS (Mercury). Measured lines are labeled by source; an estimate older than 35 days is marked stale under Margin by plan. Settled through D−2. Measured/invoiced lines are solid blue-greys: STT measured is the Soniox prepaid-balance delta plus measured Deepgram usage only; STT cash is Mercury vendor cash; measured SaaS (Mercury) is the daily SaaS aggregate. Modulate modelled (measured volume × committed price), STT est. (Soniox console) and SaaS est. (fixed) are sand-colored because they are not measured. The stack top is the Cost / day stat. One-time GCP spikes (a service-day above 2× and $500 over its 14-day median, e.g. the 2026-09-07 Coldline migration) are excluded and shown in the tooltip. Revenue (violet line) = FinOps MRR ÷ 30.4.

panels.title: Unit economics
panels.description: Revenue and all-in cost per monthly user (qualified MAU), 30-day basis, one point per day. Revenue = Omi-plan MRR ÷ that day's monthly users (FinOps book, which has daily snapshots from 2026-09-18; the latest point is the Per user stat). Cost = all-in 30-day cost through D−2 ÷ the same window's monthly users (the latest point is the Cost / user stat). The gap between the lines is the per-user margin. A day with no book snapshot breaks the line rather than being drawn. MAU here is qualified MAU (~10K). The "Omi Cost vs Revenue" artifact divides by any-event PostHog MAU (~22K, $3.41 in October), so its per-user cost is about half of this one.

Day before the oldest source read behind the wall's charts (UTC), how many series are still filling, and how many headline stats are a retained earlier value because their source failed; the wall shows stale-but-real data rather than waiting. A chart's own last point can be older (cost settles D−2; Margin by plan has its own line). Sources without a defensible read path (crash-free, answer ratings, payer churn, activated → paid, gross margin) stay off the wall; the full classified reasons are in /api/omi/stats/wall/series/headline.

description: Growth → Activation → Retention → Revenue → Health. Stats above native charts; v2 metric definitions via /api/omi/stats/wall/series. Every chart's latest point is the stat above it. The data-through day is the line under Health.
